legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment of Contract is freely assignable by Assignee, and Assignor shall not unreasonably withhold consent to any assignment.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee against any claims, damages, or expenses arising from Assignor's breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations, including but not limited to title insurance, settlement fees, and transfer taxes.
